title: at new --covers <missing AC> refuses correctly but with a PUT/POST remedy unrelated to the error
body:
The refusal is right; the remedy it prints is an HTTP one that does not describe what the caller can do at the terminal. (vc)

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.


**CLOSED 2026-09-14 15:50Z (ic, on vc's batch order).** Fixed in the commit carrying this note. The contract refusal has its own variant, `FacadeError::RowBreaksContract`, whose remedy names `intent at lint`, `intent ac list`, `intent ac new` and `intent at edit --covers`; `WriteNotAddressable` and its `PUT`/`POST` remedy stay with the `put` door. The error text is unchanged. Reproduced first with the delivered 3.0.3 pair: `at new ST0001 AT-01.1 --covers AC-99.9` printed the `PUT` json remedy. Proved by `at_new_refuses_a_row_whose_covers_matches_no_criterion` (the remedy names the verbs and no `PUT`) and a provocation in `error_remedies.rs`. `at edit` shares the refusal, so its remedy changed too.
